notes.title: Lilith: Rise of the Fallen Demo out now!
notes.content: [h1][b]LILITH DEMO IS NOW LIVE![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The time has come, sinners.[/p][p][/p][p]The Lilith demo is officially live on Steam, and you can now step into the corrupted world we’ve been building for you. Your mission? Survive. Corrupt. Conquer.[/p][p][/p][p]Face waves of relentless celestial enemies, harness infernal energy, and twist the world around you to your will. Every second you stay alive, you grow stronger. But beware: the angels won’t rest, and neither should you.[/p][p][/p][h1]Watch the Trailer now![/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="vibSGX_MU30;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]Why play the demo?[/b][/h3][p]- Test your survival skills in the horde survival system.[/p][p]-  Experiment with sin upgrades and discover synergies.[/p][p]-  Feel the pressure of a world constantly trying to cleanse your corruption.[/p][p]-  Share your feedback and shape Lilith with us before launch.[/p][p][/p][p]This is not just a demo. It’s a declaration of war against the Arbiters. Prove yourself now and let the legion taste fear.[/p][p][/p][p]🔥 Download the Lilith Demo now and join the chaos. 🔥[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be watching your runs, your strategies, and your triumphs. Share your moments, your clips, your feedback. Let’s make Lilith the game it deserves to be together.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay corrupted.[/p][p]The Flaming Dogs team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639027/7f74f936a8945f26950df3dc642a725cfae11bcd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Countdown Begins: Lilith is Almost Here!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639027/1c4664ffd48395f8bbd285e407da3bc66cabc1f4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Countdown Begins: Lilith is Almost Here![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The corruption is growing. The celestial hordes are restless. And Lilith is almost ready to unleash chaos.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re officially in countdown mode for Lilith’s launch, and it’s not just another release—it’s the moment where your survival instincts, your mastery of corruption, and your strategies will define your legend.[/p][p][/p][p]But this isn’t just about day one. Here’s what’s coming as we prepare to open the gates:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Final Demo Update Incoming!!![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re pushing a final update to the demo to sharpen your blades before the storm hits. Expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]Polished combat feel[/b]: smoother hit feedback, faster transitions, tighter dodges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New corruption VFX:[/b] see Lilith’s power reshape the map in real-time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance improvements:[/b] higher stability, smoother hordes, cleaner animations under heavy chaos.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance passes:[/b] tweaks to energy generation, dash damage, and enemy patterns.[/p][/*][/list][p]Test it. Break it. Master it. Your feedback on the demo will help us make launch day even sharper![/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait for you to play it![/p][p]The Flaming Dogs Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639027/7f74f936a8945f26950df3dc642a725cfae11bcd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Lilith: A modern day warrior.
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639027/1c4664ffd48395f8bbd285e407da3bc66cabc1f4.png"][/img]Lilith represents a modern age warrior. A woman fighting against an already established, rotten order.[/p][p][/p][p]During her fight to corrupt and destroy the arbiters, you will use the power of the Seven Deadly Sins. Each sin is a scar, a memory, and a symbol of what being human is, a scream echoing within every second you survive.[/p][p][/p][p]When you corrupt the ground, it’s not only just an attack—it’s a declaration of vengeance, of impurity, of justice.[/p][p][/p][p]Lilith isn’t here to be a hero. She doesn’t need to be. She’s a warrior looking to destroy the rotten "sacred" unwavering law that vanished her:[/p][p]– Each aggressive dash is her rage, turned into momentum.[/p][p]– Each growing aura of corruption is her hunger to destroy that which unjustly punished her.[/p][p]– Each second you survive the celestial hordes is her unbreakable will taking shape.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 You will notice this and more when you play the demo![/p][p]We want to hear your perspective:[/p][p]Which ability or mechanic made you connect with Lilith the most?[/p][p][/p][p]Let us know once the demo comes out on July 11th![/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]The flaming Dogs team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639027/7f74f936a8945f26950df3dc642a725cfae11bcd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Let's talk about gameplay!
notes.content:
[h2][b]
Let’s talk about what really matters: gameplay.[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]At the heart of [i]Lilith: Rise Of The Fallen[/i] is a system that defines everything: corruption and battlefield control.[/p][p][/p][p]Lilith doesn’t just survive the Legion’s hordes — she shapes the world around her.[/p][p][/p][p]As you move, you leave behind a trail of corruption, transforming the terrain in real time. This corrupted ground isn’t just visual; it’s your most powerful weapon. The more you corrupt, the stronger you become: skills evolve, cooldowns shrink, and new abilities awaken.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45639027/d12ae5da49e1d303f507a6860987f14e753b9beb.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]But power invites resistance — your enemies fight back. Celestial forces purify the ground, pushing against your influence. It’s a constant tug of war where territorial control becomes [i]survival[/i], and every decision matters:[/p][list][*][p]Do you spread corruption aggressively to gain momentum?     [/p][/*][*][p]Or hold key ground to protect your advantage?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This dynamic loop makes every match unpredictable, strategic, and deeply satisfying — especially for players who thrive on adaptation.[/p][p][/p][p]Corruption isn’t just a mechanic — it’s the heart of the chaos.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be sharing more soon: enemy behavior breakdowns, ability showcases, and deep dives into how terrain affects gameplay in later stages.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Missed our teaser trailer?[/b][/h3][p]You can check it out right here:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="c8yjzzUkykg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🖤 Wishlist [i]Lilith: Rise Of The Fallen[/i][/b] so you don’t miss future updates, deep dives, or our upcoming demo.[/h3][p][/p][p]Follow us on social media for early peeks and development stories straight from The Fallen's frontlines.[/p][p]Thanks for being part of this journey.[/p][p][/p][p]— The Flaming Dogs Team 🐾🔥[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45639027/7f74f936a8945f26950df3dc642a725cfae11bcd.png"][/img]
[/p]

notes.title: Lilith: Rise Of The Fallen is now on Steam!
notes.content:
[p]It’s official! [i]Lilith: Rise Of The Fallen[/i], the debut title from [b]Flaming Dogs Studios,[/b] now has its own Steam page! From now on, this space will be your go-to hub for all updates: dev blogs, concept art, gameplay previews, behind-the-scenes content — and yes, a playable demo is on the way![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe_3kz3v5yqxsbWohF7ryArr1KfoPUq9EFHnvmNXMNEWQQdiFB3PhotMA9hZjKlxLKWSt3x2yiedvxERDfVns505cQmjLHYQ4vCP6C1k6D6r851KVGsmm3M1S5a9rKuxM2kdsFz?key=R7r4Ry5QiQPRHfXks8sogw"][/img][/p][p][i]Lilith: Rise Of The Fallen[/i] blends [b]shoot’em up[/b] and [b]horde survival[/b] genres in a dark, symbolic universe where players take on the role of mythical character Lilith, a demonic entity fighting off relentless celestial hordes. Through a dynamic corruption system, players can transform the battlefield to suit their playstyle, create tactical advantages, and survive waves of enemies with unique behaviors.[/p][p]This is just the beginning of a journey we want to share with all of you. If you’re into chaotic action, strategic survival and games with a strong visual and narrative identity, you’re in the right place.[/p][p][/p][p]You can take a look at our teaser trailer here:
[/p][previewyoutube="c8yjzzUkykg;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🖤 [b]Don’t want to miss anything?[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Add the game to your Wishlist[/b] to be notified when major updates and the demo go live.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Follow us on social media[/b] for exclusive content, early looks, and development insights.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for joining us at the start of this adventure.[/p][p]More updates from hell are coming soon.[/p][p]— The Flaming Dogs Team 🐾🔥
